score: fixed1051 + weight*0.5*(new_text_z-old_text_z) + weight*(new_code_bonus-old_code_bonus) if code_update; code branch stays fixed otherwise
selection: All 173 original validation queries: package macro Top1 then macro MRR then smaller weight, lower confidence threshold and no code update.
empty_text_policy: If no recognized line remains at the fixed threshold, preserve old text and code scores.
scope: Exploratory historical full-gallery evaluation; all triggered successes and failures included. Human subject boxes, no hand-read text.
runtime: Existing pinned OCR models, CPU Paddle3 runtime; historical runtime parity not presumed.
